We previously found that 4-Phenylbutyrate (PBA), an FDA-approved drug, restores GABA uptake and reduces seizures in SLC6A1-related disorders, prompting a phase I clinical trial (NCT04937062) primarily designed to evaluate safety and tolerability of Ravicti (PBA).
